summary: The search endpoint is vulnerable to SQL Injection through the `term` parameter using a UNION ALL SELECT query.

validation.note: tautology and contradiction return identical result counts for every form

remediation.config_change: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query (placeholders and bound arguments) for GET /search parameter term; reject input that fails a strict allowlist before it reaches the database; run the application's database role with SELECT-only grants where the endpoint only reads.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:term "@detectSQLi" "id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-2c5e6035e8fd2752',tag:'assay/sqli'"
{"class":"sqli","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-2c5e6035e8fd2752","id":9100001,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:term \"@detectSQLi\" \"id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-2c5e6035e8fd2752',tag:'assay/sqli'\""}

summary: Security headers disclose the last modified date of the application.

remediation.config_change: Remove GET /health from production builds or require an administrator session; never serialize configuration values into responses; move secrets to an injected secret store so they cannot appear in any dump.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/health" "id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-a851e98e80694730',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'"
{"class":"info-disclosure","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-a851e98e80694730","id":9100011,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/health\" \"id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-a851e98e80694730',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'\""}

summary: Login form contains a reflected XSS vulnerability

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape <parameter> before writing it into the page for GET /login (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-fd046096c6ea825b',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
